description: Modular desk/workstation kit with 3 visual states for NLT World Engine workplace scenarios.
author: Pool (art) + Kilo (pipeline)

states.name: Clean
states.description: Minimalist desk setup: desktop, legs, monitor (screen ON), keyboard, mouse, chair, pen holder, notebook, small plant.

states.name: Cluttered
states.description: Busy workday desk: base + scattered papers, coffee mug, book stack, cables, sticky notes, phone, earbuds.

states.name: AfterHours
states.description: Late-night desk: monitor screen OFF, desk lamp, wine glass, open book, reading glasses, jacket draped over chair, energy drink can.

notes: Import each state FBX into UE as a separate Static Mesh or Level Instance.
Assign corresponding UE material instances from M_ list above.
ScreenOn and ScreenOff materials should use emissive for the display surface.
Base collection (desk, chair, monitor, keyboard, mouse) is shared across states; reuse a single mesh asset and swap prop visibility/materials at runtime for efficiency.
Clutter objects are additive; after-hours objects replace clean-state props where appropriate.
